title: Locally Koszul-regular ideal
statement: Let $T$ be a commutative ring and $L$ an ideal of $T$. The ideal $L$ is locally Koszul-regular if for every prime ideal $p$ of $T$ containing $L$ there exist $u\in T\setminus p$, $r\geq 0$, and $a_1,\ldots,a_r\in T_u$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] such that $LT_u=(a_1,\ldots,a_r)$ and the sequence $(a_1,\ldots,a_r)$ is Koszul-regular [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. The empty sequence is allowed; the unit ideal satisfies this condition vacuously.
